candidate_decisions.reason: The native 18:1-18:2 contact supplies the focus Book, descent, and no-crookedness carriers and independently connects them to uprightness, warning, glad tidings, intentional work, and recompense. The resulting relation changes the Book from a merely error-free object into an aligned communication whose form enables its warning and promise functions.

The channel evidence adds a distinct direct-action relation: the descended written Book is an active standard whose alignment prevents the conduct it calls for from being semantically distorted. Its action-oriented payoff is not exhausted by the warning-and-promise finding.

The exact HFT two-way-instrument reading is carried by macro:unwarped-book-warning-promise. That finding lands all four branches, the 18:2 context, and the supplied before/after and activation-trace relation without excluding any part of this candidate.

The exact 18:5 trace supplies a distinct contact between the written Book's connected form and mouth-born speech that emerges without knowledge and is named falsehood. The trace is pericope-scoped and its unresolved branches survive as attributed contextual evidence.

The 18:7-18:8 trace creates a materially distinct stability relation: praise after examination and the repeated making of an adorned then stripped earth make the Book's preserved straightness legible as a criterion amid mutable appearances. Exact focus carriers are combined with attributed contextual branches.

The 18:10 and 18:16 traces give descent a distinct protective-provision contact: the Book on the servant meets refuge, preparation, and usable benefit. The resulting sheltering-agency reading is bounded as an attributed contextual analogy and does not replace descent or servanthood.

The 18:9 and 18:13 trace supplies an accountable-sequence relation through a marked record, retraceable narration, and correspondence with reality. It is distinct from the 18:5 contrast with loose speech and retains the supplied qualification that the inference is contextual.

The 18:21, 18:22, and 18:26 trace creates a separate epistemic-boundary relation: the Book's straightness meets warranted truth, conjectural throwing at the unseen, contentious dispute, and firm judgment. The reading changes what straightness authorizes without collapsing into the traceability finding.

The exact exploratory trace connects the focus's physical-curvature branch with uprightness and the supplied recompense branch in 18:2. Its material repair image passes as a contained analogy because the packet explicitly preserves the reward reading and states the branch-distance boundary.

The exact exploratory trace connects the focus's physical-curvature branch with the cave's controlled veering, passing-aside, and repeated turning. The result is a bounded analogy about preserving purpose through non-direct motion, not a claim that the Book itself is crooked.

findings.title: An aligned Book makes warning and promise operative
findings.claim: The Book named in 18:1 is not only delivered and free of abstract crookedness; within the immediate continuation, its aligned form is what lets warning awaken caution and good news open a promised course whose outcome is tied to intentional action and recompense.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers are the written Book, divine delivery, and the denial of abstract deviation. They meet the independently supplied uprightness, warning, glad tidings, intentional work, and recompense occurrences in 18:2. The contact turns straightness into an active relation between the Book's form and the two directions of its address: danger becomes legible and faithful action receives a determinate promise. The represented HFT transition is before: Straightness means only that the book is free of error. After: Straightness is active calibration: the book exposes ruinous direction while opening a viable promised course.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the final clause as more than a bare quality-control statement: the Book's straightness joins its shape to what it does for its recipients, holding caution and hope in one communication.
findings.containment: This remains inside the plain claim that Allah sent the Book to His servant without crookedness. The warning, promise, action, and recompense are a macro relation supplied by 18:2; they do not replace the Book's descent, its recipient, or the primary denial of crookedness. The HFT trace also permits the clauses to name independent effects rather than one instrument; that counter-reading remains live.

epistemic.reason: The channel support is trusted and the native 18:2 contact is exact, while the HFT record represented here is a legacy-unbound reconstructed nomination. The semantic relation is therefore retained with its source qualification visible.

findings.title: Straightness sets the boundary of warranted speech
findings.claim: The Book's straightness can consist in affirming what is warranted while refusing crooked overreach into disputed matters that remain unseen.
findings.mechanism: The focus Book's binding-judgment facet and abstract-deviation carrier meet the later supplied roles of warranted truth, conjectural throwing at the unseen, contentious doubt, and firm judgment. The contact changes straightness from an expectation of total disclosure into a disciplined boundary around what the Book authorizes one to claim. The supplied HFT transition is before: A straight book is expected to disclose every disputed detail. After: Its straightness can instead consist in saying decisively what is warranted and refusing crooked overreach into what remains unseen.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why a straight Book may be precise through restraint: its integrity includes a limit on speculation, not a promise to answer every disputed detail.
findings.containment: The epistemic boundary is an attributed pericope relation. It does not erase the Book's written and delivered identity, and it does not decide whether every later restriction is a universal doctrine rather than a local response to the cave count.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and later ayah anchors are supplied, but every later branch identity in this trace is unresolved and the reader record is legacy-unbound.

findings.title: A contained image of setting a bend
findings.claim: The focus's denial of crookedness can support a contained material analogy in which upright scripture resembles a setting that restores a bent fracture, while 18:2's recompense remains its ordinary surface meaning.
findings.mechanism: The physical-curvature facet of the focus occurrence meets the supplied uprightness occurrence and the attributed repair-related recompense branch at 18:2. Their contact produces a restorative image: a bend is set into alignment rather than merely declared absent. The supplied HFT transition is before: The book simply has no bend. After: As a contained material analogy, upright scripture behaves like a setting that restores a bent fracture, with just recompense participating in repaired alignment.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel straightness as a repaired alignment while still hearing the Book's plain claim that it contains no crookedness.
findings.containment: This is explicitly an exploratory analogy. أَجْرًا in 18:2 remains reward or recompense in the surface syntax; the analogy cannot replace that reading and cannot literalize the Book as a splint.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is exact and its containment explicitly preserves the reward reading, but the repair branch is unresolved and the source is legacy-unbound.

findings.title: Purpose can remain straight through controlled turns
findings.claim: The focus's denial of crookedness can support a contained analogy in which a straight purpose is preserved through controlled turns that route around danger rather than following a geometrically direct line.
findings.mechanism: The physical-curvature branch on the focus occurrence meets the attributed veering, passing-aside, and repeated-turning roles in 18:17-18. These motions are not treated as defects; their contact changes the meaning of straightness from direct geometry to integrity of intended direction. The supplied HFT transition is before: Straightness requires every effective path to be geometrically direct. After: The cave scene suggests that purpose can remain straight through controlled turns: oblique motions preserve rather than distort the intended end.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold directness and protection together: a path may turn while its purpose remains intact.
findings.containment: This remains an exploratory analogy around the focus's physical branch. It does not make the Book crooked, does not replace the abstract no-deviation reading, and does not claim that every turn is straight.

epistemic.reason: The HFT anchors and roles are supplied but legacy-unbound, and all three contextual branch descriptors are unresolved; the trace's explicit containment supports retaining the analogy with low certainty language avoided.

findings.title: The added plea for a straight path gives straightness a route
findings.claim: The explicitly added 1:6 plea for guidance on a straight path gives the focus's no-crookedness a bounded route-oriented resonance: the Book's integrity can be heard as carrying a recipient toward a straight course.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier is the abstract-deviation noun in 18:1. After native/pericope review is quarantined, the external 1:6 occurrence مُسْتَقِيمَ supplies the independent straightness trigger, with the neighboring request for guidance and named path fixing the contact as a requested route rather than a whole-surah theme.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive one concrete external delta: straightness is not only a property of the Book's form but can meet a request for a course to be made straight.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory Phase-2 overlay only. It does not import the whole Fātiḥa, does not suppress the native warning, promise, shelter, or epistemic findings, and does not claim that 18:1 itself contains the wording of 1:6.

epistemic.reason: The focus and external lean context supply exact carrier and word-position evidence, and the nominated straightness branch is packet-supported; no dedicated external HFT or connection record is supplied, so the overlay remains an explicit inference.
